hyperionaidev/smolmaxxing.excerpt: # 🤏 smolmaxxing / **Run the biggest language model you can on the smallest hardware you own.** / TV boxes, old phones and tablets, single-board computers and routers all have a CPU, some RAM and flash storage that sit idle most of the day. smolmaxxing finds the biggest model each of them can really run, then pushes it further with custom kernels, careful memory use and weights streamed from flash. Every number in this repo was measured on the device itself. / ## Three devices so far / The TV box and the iPad run 8B and 16B mixture-of-experts models on about 1 GB of RAM, and the phone runs 35B and 80B ones with about 3 GB free.
